# Reverse an array

Source: [4826](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4826); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4826-n1"></a>

- Documented array reversal uses Sorted Array(array, Current Array Index * -1); Sorted Array sorts keys ascending.

<a id="wiki-4826-n2"></a>

- Current Array Element and Current Array Index are available in sorted/mapped/filtered array expressions; sorting by a positive current index preserves original order.
